title: Adding a new App-SDK app requires two wiring edits in pkg/registry/apps
answers: What breaks if I forget to wire a new app installer?
How do I register a new app in pkg/registry/apps?
Why isn't my new AppInstaller being picked up by the API server?
body: A new app's installer provider must be added to BOTH `pkg/registry/apps/wireset.go` (`appregistry.WireSet`, so `wire` knows how to construct the installer) AND the parameter list + body of `pkg/registry/apps/apps.go:ProvideAppInstallers` (which assembles the final `[]appsdkapiserver.AppInstaller` slice, with feature-toggle gating per app). Skipping the wireset entry breaks `wire` codegen (`pkg/server/bootstrap/wire/wire_gen.go` won't have the dependency); skipping the ProvideAppInstallers entry means the installer is constructed but never reaches `pkg/services/apiserver/service.go`'s `appInstallers` list, so the app's schema/admission/OpenAPI/authorizer never get registered even though its code compiles and wire is happy. `pkg/registry/apps/apps_test.go:TestProvideAppInstallers` exercises this wiring with various featuremgmt toggle combinations — extend it when adding a gated app.
applies: Only for apps added under pkg/registry/apps/ that implement appsdkapiserver.AppInstaller; unrelated to pkg/registry/apis API-group builders (which have their own separate wireset/sink pair).

search: Adding a new App-SDK app requires two wiring edits: pkg/registry/apps/wireset.go:WireSet (so wire codegen succeeds with pkg/server/bootstrap/wire/wire_gen.go) and pkg/registry/apps/apps.go:ProvideAppInstallers parameters and body (to reach pkg/services/apiserver/service.go's appInstallers list). Skipping the wireset breaks wire codegen; skipping ProvideAppInstallers leaves the installer constructed but unreachable, silently preventing schema/admission/OpenAPI registration. Feature-gated apps must be wired in ProvideAppInstallers with toggle guards; extend pkg/registry/apps/apps_test.go:TestProvideAppInstallers to cover new gated combinations. Applies only to apps under pkg/registry/apps/ implementing appsdkapiserver.AppInstaller, not API-group builders.
